# Data Source: tfe_github_app_installation

Gets information about the Github App installation.

At least one of `InstallationId` or `Name` must be set.

## Example Usage

```csharp
using Constructs;
using HashiCorp.Cdktf;
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
using Gen.Providers.Tfe;
class MyConvertedCode : TerraformStack
{
    public MyConvertedCode(Construct scope, string name) : base(scope, name)
    {
        new DataTfeGithubAppInstallation.DataTfeGithubAppInstallation(this, "gha_installation", new DataTfeGithubAppInstallationConfig {
            InstallationId = 12345678
        });
    }
}
```

```csharp
using Constructs;
using HashiCorp.Cdktf;
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
using Gen.Providers.Tfe;
class MyConvertedCode : TerraformStack
{
    public MyConvertedCode(Construct scope, string name) : base(scope, name)
    {
        new DataTfeGithubAppInstallation.DataTfeGithubAppInstallation(this, "gha_installation", new DataTfeGithubAppInstallationConfig {
            Name = "github_username_or_organization"
        });
    }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `InstallationId` (Number) ID of the Github Installation. The installation ID can be found in the URL slug when visiting the installation's configuration page, e.g `Https://githubCom/settings/installations/12345678`.
- `Name` (String) Name of the Github user or organization account that installed the app.

### Read-Only

- `Id` (String) The internal ID of the Github Installation. This is different from the `InstallationId`.
